corporation_name.rationale: Corporation name is a header field not represented as a leaf element in the Schedule M-2 canonical schema.

ein.rationale: EIN is a header field not represented as a leaf element in the Schedule M-2 canonical schema.

tax_year_begin.rationale: Tax year begin date is a header field not represented as a leaf element in the Schedule M-2 canonical schema.

tax_year_end.rationale: Tax year end date is a header field not represented as a leaf element in the Schedule M-2 canonical schema.

m2_aaa_beginning.rationale: BalanceBOYAccumAdjAcctAmt maps to AAA beginning-of-year balance (column a, line 1).

m2_aaa_ordinary_income.rationale: OrdinaryBusinessIncomeAmt maps to ordinary income added to AAA (column a, line 2).

m2_aaa_other_additions.rationale: TotalOtherAddnAccumAdjAcctAmt maps to other additions to AAA (column a, line 3).

m2_aaa_loss_and_deductions.rationale: OrdinaryBusinessLossAmt maps to loss and deductions subtracted from AAA (column a, line 4).

m2_aaa_other_reductions.rationale: OtherReductionsAccumAdjAcctAmt maps to other reductions to AAA (column a, line 5).

m2_aaa_combined.rationale: SubtotalAccumAdjAcctAmt maps to the combined subtotal of AAA lines 1-5 (column a, line 6).

m2_aaa_distributions.rationale: NotDivDistriAccumAdjAcctAmt maps to distributions charged against AAA (column a, line 7).

m2_aaa_end.rationale: BalanceEOYAccumAdjAcctAmt maps to AAA end-of-year balance (column a, line 8).

m2_oaa_beginning.rationale: BalanceBOYOtherAdjAcctAmt maps to OAA beginning-of-year balance (column b, line 1).

m2_oaa_end.rationale: BalanceEOYOtherAdjAcctAmt maps to OAA end-of-year balance (column b, line 8).

m2_shareholders_undistributed_taxable_be.rationale: BalBOYShrUndistrTxblIncmAmt maps to shareholders' undistributed taxable income previously taxed at beginning of year (column c, line 1).

m2_shareholders_undistributed_taxable_en.rationale: BalEOYShrUndistrTxblIncmAmt maps to shareholders' undistributed taxable income previously taxed at end of year (column c, line 8).
